snippet.title: Умерла мама Кевина из «Один дома»
snippet.description:
Умерла мама Кевина из «Один дома». Макалей Калкин трогательно отреагировал на печальное известие.

Актриса Кэтрин О’Хара скончалась 30 января в своём доме в Лос-Анджелесе. Ей был 71 год. В наших сердцах она навсегда останется мамой Кевина из легендарного «Один дома».

Макалей Калкин посвятил ей трогательное послание:

«Мама. Я думал, у нас еще есть время. Я хотел большего. Хотел посидеть в кресле рядом с тобой. Я люблю тебя. Увидимся позже»

Кроме знаменитой роли в новогодней комедии, Кэтрин запомнилась многим, как Мойра Роуз из сериала «Шиттс Крик». За которую в 20 году получила премию Эмми.

snippet.title: Catherine O'Hara's Birthday Would Be Today — And Macaulay Culkin's Tribute Still Breaks Us 💔🕯️✨
snippet.description:
Today would have been Catherine O'Hara's birthday — and the world is still grieving. 💔 Catherine O'Hara passed away on January 30th, 2026, at her home in Los Angeles following a brief illness, at the age of 71. Born in Toronto in 1954, she launched her career at Second City in the 1970s alongside Eugene Levy, Martin Short and John Candy — before becoming one of the most beloved comedic actors of her generation. Most of the world knew her as the frantic, loving mom Kate McCallister in Home Alone — and as the unforgettable Moira Rose in Schitt's Creek. But for Macaulay Culkin, she was simply "Mama." Culkin posted two photos on Instagram — one from the Home Alone set in 1990, and one from her speech at his Hollywood Walk of Fame ceremony in December 2023 — writing: "Mama. I thought we had time. I wanted more. I wanted to sit in a chair next to you. I heard you but I had so much more to say. I love you. I'll see you later." At that Walk of Fame ceremony, O'Hara had praised Culkin's performance saying: "Home Alone was, is, and always will be a beloved global sensation — and the reason families all over the world can't let a year go by without watching it is because of Macaulay Culkin." Director Chris Columbus said it plainly: "Catherine carries the weight of 50% of that film. The movie simply would not work without her extraordinary performance." Martin Short, who knew her since she was 18, raised a glass to her on stage the same night she passed, calling her "the greatest, most brilliant, kindest, sweetest angel." Happy Birthday Catherine. We're so glad you were here.

snippet.title: She Quit SNL Before Her First Show…😳🎬
snippet.description:
Catherine O'Hara started out as a waitress at The Second City in Toronto and soon joined its TV show, SCTV. In 1981, Saturday Night Live hired her, but when SCTV was picked up again she quit before ever appearing on air. "Oh, sorry, I gotta go be with my family," she later said, meaning her SCTV castmates. She went back and won an Emmy for writing the show. She became Kevin's mom in Home Alone, but big Hollywood roles didn't follow. Decades later, a small Canadian show, Schitt's Creek, made her Moira Rose, and at 66 she won the Emmy for best actress, almost forty years after her first, as the show swept all seven major comedy Emmys, a first for a comedy. She died in January 2026, at 71. "Mama, I thought we had time," wrote Macaulay Culkin.

snippet.title: What many people don't know about Catherine O’Hara
snippet.description:
Catherine O’Hara, Comedy Icon and ‘Schitt’s Creek’ Star, Dies at 71
Mama, I thought we had time...
Tributes From Hollywood
The reaction was immediate and deeply emotional, particularly from those who played her family members on screen.

Macaulay Culkin, who played her son Kevin in the “Home Alone” films, shared a heartbreaking tribute on Instagram. “Mama, I thought we had time,” he wrote, alongside a photo of them together from his Hollywood Walk of Fame ceremony just two years prior. “I wanted more. I wanted to sit in a chair next to you. I heard you. But I had so much more to say. I love you. I’ll see you later.”

Eugene Levy, her frequent collaborator of nearly 50 years, from the Second City stage to “Best in Show” and finally “Schitt’s Creek,” released a brief statement through a representative: “The world is a little less bright today. Catherine was more than a partner; she was the heartbeat of every room she walked into. To have shared a life of laughter with her was the greatest gift of my career.”

Pedro Pascal, who recently worked with her on the upcoming season of “The Last of Us,” posted: “Oh, genius to be near you. Eternally grateful. There is less light in my world.”

Other peers, including Meryl Streep, Martin Short, and Seth Rogen, remembered her as a “comic giant” and a “whipsmart” collaborator.

A Legacy of Laughter
Born in Toronto in 1954, Ms. O’Hara began her career in the mid-1970s at Toronto’s Second City, where she eventually became a founding member of the influential sketch show “SCTV.” It was there that she honed her ability to inhabit wildly eccentric characters, a skill she would later use to transform into the wig-wearing, accent-shifting Moira Rose.

Her film career was equally storied. She became a household name as the panicked Kate McCallister in “Home Alone” (1990) and was a staple of Christopher Guest’s mockumentaries, including “Waiting for Guffman” and “Best in Show.”

In recent years, Ms. O’Hara experienced a massive resurgence in popularity. Her performance in “Schitt’s Creek” earned her an Emmy for Lead Actress in a Comedy Series in 2020, and she had recently earned critical acclaim for her roles in “The Studio” and the second season of “The Last of Us.”

Fans and medical experts also noted her openness regarding her rare condition, dextrocardia with situs inversus—a congenital condition where her heart was on the right side of her chest. While she often joked about being a “freak,” she used her platform to bring awareness to the condition with her trademark wit.

Ms. O’Hara is survived by her husband of 33 years, the production designer Bo Welch, and their two sons, Matthew and Luke.

snippet.title: Catherine O’Hara মারা গেলেন ৭১ বছর বয়সে Home Alone এবং Schitt’s Creek তারকা
snippet.description:
হলিউড অভিনেত্রী Catherine O’Hara ৭১ বছর বয়সে মারা গেছেন।
তিনি Los Angeles-এ নিজের বাসায় সংক্ষিপ্ত অসুস্থতা-র পর প্রয়াত হন।

O’Hara সবচেয়ে বেশি পরিচিত ছিলেন Home Alone সিনেমায় Kevin McCallister-এর মায়ের চরিত্রে।
তিনি Schitt’s Creek সিটকমে Moira Rose-এর চরিত্রে অভিনয় করে Emmy এবং Golden Globe জিতেছিলেন।

তিনি কানাডায় শুরু করেছিলেন স্কেচ শো Second City Television থেকে, যেখানে প্রথম Emmy পান।
মুভি Beetlejuice-এ অভিনয় করেছেন এবং 2024 সালে Beetlejuice সিক্যুয়েলেও অভিনয় করেছেন।
তিনি সম্প্রতি The Last of Us এবং Seth Rogen-এর The Studio-তেও অভিনয় করেছেন।

Home Alone-এর তার সহ-অভিনেতা Macaulay Culkin ইন্সটাগ্রামে লিখেছেন:
"Mama. I thought we had time. I wanted more. I love you. I’ll see you later."

**Screen Actors Guild (SAG-AFTRA)**ও তাকে শ্রদ্ধা জানিয়েছে এবং বলেছেন তিনি ছিলেন beloved actor and comedian।

O’Hara তার স্বামী Bo Welch, দুই ছেলে এবং ভাইবোনদের দ্বারা বেঁচে আছেন।
পরিবার একটি private celebration of life করবে।

ও’হারাকে মনে রাখা হবে Hollywood-এর comedic icon হিসেবে, যার ক্যারিয়ার ৫০ বছরের বেশি সময় ধরে চলেছিল।
